idea-plugin.name: Unused npm Script Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter icon on every entry of an open package.json's "scripts" section, showing whether that script is actually referenced anywhere in your project -- or an orphan nobody calls, a real candidate for cleanup.

Where it looks (v0.1):

  • The package.json's own other scripts ("build": "npm run clean && npm run compile" marks clean/compile as used).
  • GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml) and GitLab CI (.gitlab-ci.yml) next to the package.json.
  • README.md next to the package.json.

Only real invocations count -- npm run <name>, yarn <name>, pnpm <name> / pnpm run <name> -- never a bare word match, so a script named build is never flagged as "used" just because the word appears unrelated somewhere in a README paragraph.

npm lifecycle scripts (pretest/test/ posttest, prepare/prepublishOnly, preinstall/postinstall, preversion/postversion, start, and any real script's own pre/post hook) are never flagged as orphaned, even with zero text references -- npm runs those automatically by convention.

100% static text/PSI analysis of files already open in your project -- no network call, no Node.js/npm process spawned. A project with no package.json, or one with no "scripts" section, is handled as an honest no-op, never a crash.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
